newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0755 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Up 0.100 to off 0.100 cent. Follow-through support likely from Friday. However, lower cash beef prices Friday and talk of poor holiday weekend sales bearish.
FEEDER CATTLE - Mixed. Should follow direction of live cattle. Latest CME feeder cattle index down $0.09 cent at $76.17 per cwt.
LEAN HOGS - Off 0.100 to 0.200 cent. Lower cash hog calls and mostly lower cash pork products bearish for futures.
PORK BELLIES - Steady to off 0.400 cent. Shortcovering and light slaughter week may keep futures steady early. But weakness in May contract may take others down.
